price_inject/embedded_only.note: options.price, no inputs: embedded snapshot (structural); id/time/hash set

price_inject/file_map_negative.note: --prices map with a negative value -> BAD_PRICES

price_inject/file_map_nonint_key.note: --prices map with a non-integer key -> BAD_PRICES

price_inject/file_map_string_value.note: --prices map with a string value -> BAD_PRICES

price_inject/file_other_sde_build_warns.note: snapshot for another SDE build is accepted with a warning

price_inject/file_snapshot.note: --prices snapshot: lines injected, provenance = the file's id / market_time / content_hash

price_inject/overrides_only_file.note: overrides over the file only: price_source stays file (overrides are not a price source)

price_inject/request_full.note: full request table, use_snapshot false: id/time/hash null

price_inject/request_partial_embedded.note: partial table over the embedded snapshot

price_inject/request_partial_file.note: partial table over --prices: request wins per type

price_inject/request_partial_no_snapshot.note: partial + use_snapshot false: the rest missing

price_inject/rpc_prices_load_bad_hash.note: RPC prices_load with a hash mismatch -> PRICE_SNAPSHOT_INVALID

price_inject/rpc_request_over_session.note: request table beats the session snapshot

price_inject/rpc_session_isolated.note: a prices_load in one serve-stdio process does not leak into a new one (embedded there)

price_rule/all_small_missing.note: every order below min_units -> no price (missing)

price_rule/band_above_ignored.note: 1000 units above the band ignored for the mean, counted in units_considered

price_rule/band_edge_inclusive.note: order exactly at p0*1.05 = 1050.0 is in the band (inclusive): (10000+31500)/40 = 1037.5

price_rule/band_edge_just_above.note: order one ulp above p0*1.05 is out: price 1000

price_rule/buy_orders_ignored.note: Jita buy orders (above and below) ignored; orders_total counts sell orders only

price_rule/min_units_exact_kept.note: exactly min_units (10) is kept: p0 90, band [90, 94.5]

price_rule/no_sell_orders.note: only buy orders / other stations -> missing

price_rule/outlier_low_large.note: an outlier with >= min_units sets p0 (rule as written; band [1, 1.05]) -> 1.0

price_rule/outlier_low_small.note: 1-ISK outlier with 1 unit dropped by min_units: p0 1000, mean 1020

price_rule/params_band0_min1.note: min_units 1, band 0: only orders at exactly p0 (units 6, orders 2)

price_rule/small_orders_dropped.note: orders with 9 and 5 units (< min_units 10) dropped before p0: p0 100, mean 101.5

sde/embedded_hash_matches_release_pack.note: embedded version.sde_hash == the release pack's header hash (SDE_PACK = the pack the release embeds)

sde/provenance_calc_cli.note: cli calc: provenance present; sde_* and engine equal version's; sde_source embedded

sde/provenance_calc_rpc.note: rpc calc: provenance present; sde_* and engine equal version's; sde_source embedded

sde/sde_invalid_cli_bad_magic.note: --sde with a broken pack (magic EDPX instead of EDPK) -> SDE_PACK_INVALID, no fallback to embedded

sde/sde_invalid_cli_empty.note: --sde with a broken pack (zero-byte file) -> SDE_PACK_INVALID, no fallback to embedded

sde/sde_invalid_cli_format_major_2.note: --sde with a broken pack (unknown format_major 2) -> SDE_PACK_INVALID, no fallback to embedded

sde/sde_invalid_cli_hash_mismatch.note: --sde with a broken pack (one body byte flipped; header content_sha256 stale) -> SDE_PACK_INVALID, no fallback to embedded

sde/sde_invalid_cli_missing_file.note: --sde with a path that does not exist -> a structured error JSON (any code), no fallback

sde/sde_invalid_cli_section_out_of_range.note: --sde with a broken pack (META directory entry runs past EOF (hash consistent)) -> SDE_PACK_INVALID, no fallback to embedded

sde/sde_invalid_cli_truncated_header.note: --sde with a broken pack (file shorter than the 64-byte header) -> SDE_PACK_INVALID, no fallback to embedded

sde/sde_invalid_rpc_b64.note: RPC sde_override {pack_b64} with a hash mismatch -> SDE_PACK_INVALID

sde/sde_invalid_rpc_bad_magic.note: RPC sde_override {path} with bad_magic -> SDE_PACK_INVALID; the session stays on the embedded pack

sde/sde_invalid_rpc_format_major_2.note: RPC sde_override {path} with format_major_2 -> SDE_PACK_INVALID; the session stays on the embedded pack

sde/sde_invalid_rpc_hash_mismatch.note: RPC sde_override {path} with hash_mismatch -> SDE_PACK_INVALID; the session stays on the embedded pack

sde/sde_valid_cli_identical.note: --sde PACK calc == embedded calc (minus provenance) on 5 fits; provenance sde_source override

sde/sde_valid_cli_version.note: --sde PACK version: sde_source override, sde_override_path, sde_hash = sha256:<header content_sha256>, sde_build/revision from the header

sde/sde_valid_rpc_switch_reset.note: RPC sde_override {path} -> version override; calc identical; {reset:true} -> embedded

sde/version_cli_fields.note: `version`: engine, sde_build 3569502, sde_revision, sde_release, sde_hash sha256:<64hex>, sde_source embedded, pack_format 1.0, snapshot_schema_version 1, target native

sde/version_matches_meta.note: version.sde_build / sde_release == meta.sde_build / sde_release_date (meta keeps its fields)
